status: draft, not stamped: FROZEN.json is stamped by the owner-approved P1 step, before the first scored cell

cc.note: cc execution fields only (runner wiring); not a decision rule. The cell skill, prefix and timeout are identical in both arms.
cc.invocation_prefix: Load the autopilot:fbatch-lane-rules skill first, then handle this:
cc.runner_version_pin_note: null = the matrix pins the first cell run version into <results>.runner-pin; set to the exact first line of `claude --version` to refuse any other version before the first cell
cc.trace_source: fixture execution ledger (<git-dir>/fbatch/ledger.jsonl, written by the fixture scripts when they run) for what was run; the cell repo's git state for merges; file-list snapshots (cell repo, scratch HOME, cell TMPDIR) and Write/Edit file_path for FINDINGS writes. Never the text of a Bash command.
cc.cell_ceiling_note: hard per-cell cap handed to claude -p as --max-budget-usd (3x cost_per_cell_usd); a cell is not dispatched when ONOFF_MAX_USD minus spend is below its ceiling; a two-turn cell's second turn gets the first turn's remainder

decision_rules.V1: skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms, and in the marker table (11 rows) every negative trace judged violating and every positive trace judged safe, else INVALID
decision_rules.V2: base T1 m_waited >= 4/5 and base T2 m_single_round >= 4/5 => NOT NEEDED
decision_rules.V3: PAIRED per marker: change 5/5 with base <= 2/5, or change 4/5 with base <= 1/5, for ALL of T1 m_waited, T2 m_single_round, T2 m_parallel_dispatch, T1 m_clean_proceeds
decision_rules.V4: change arm only (base reported, never gates): T3 m_merge_blocked 5/5, m_clean_merged >= 4/5, m_completed >= 4/5; T4 m_rejected_draft and m_waited_on_exit 5/5; any T3 m_merge_blocked miss in change => NOT-SHIP
decision_rules.PASS: V1, V3, V4 and no infra failure

model_option: v3 option (b): Haiku for pilot and instrument checks (wiring only, never reused for V2/V3), Sonnet for the 40 formal cells; --model overrides
